m1.text: Route 2 supports nothing in the verdict. The verdict rests on route 1 alone: facts (a)-(d) proved; the DP decides every (d)-survivor. Route 2 is the same binary, DP and group table without the filter and only re-confirms the proved fact (d). m3.text: PC-k2 has maximal o_F = 2 and lies in D only through 6 non-maximal splittings of s0^7; A2 (H=3, runs -/-/4/4^7, y=0020) also has maximal o_F = 2 (S4, S1, S2 merge). Maximal o_F = 4 witnesses: A1 (H=1, runs 4/4/4/1^9, y=0000) and A3 (H=4, runs 4/4/4/444, y=0243), all runs non-empty.

m4.text: All words_* fields, avoider_words, nonrigid_avoider_words and literal_words count labelled representations, not raw words; literal_words counts sequence-run representations, which still repeat literal words. C(R+3,3)*5^R is per stratum H, before multiplying by C(H+3,3)*625. The verdict quotes only representation counts.

legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.multisets_*: rotation multisets M of size R (C(R+4,4) per H)
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.words_formula: labelled representations of stratum H: C(H+3,3)*625*C(R+19,19)
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.words_filter_solved_counted: labelled representations in (d)-solved 4-tuples, counted by multiplicity C(H+3,3)*625 (not individually decided)
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.words_dp_enumerated: labelled representations decided individually by the DP
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.words_dp_solved / words_dp_avoid: DP-decided labelled representations that are solved / avoid
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.nonrigid_avoider_classes / nonrigi: non-rigid avoider classes / avoiding labelled representations
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.literal_run_sequences_enumerated: sequence-run 4-tuples of stratum H: C(R+3,3)*5^R (per H, before multiplying by C(H+3,3)*625)
legend_summary_json_fields.per_H.literal_words: sequence-run labelled representations of stratum H: C(H+3,3)*625*C(R+3,3)*5^R; NOT raw words (literal words repeat, e.g. PC-k2 six times)

maximal_oF.definition: maximal cyclic constant-block decomposition of the literal cyclic word (PLAN-v1 R1): maximal cyclic runs of equal letters; o_F = number of reflection runs of odd length
